description: The orders of the app's physical products (a product with `shipping`, neblla_create_product; Dinero › Ventas in the dashboard). Each paid physical product is an order with the buyer's address (name, phone, address), the zone and postage paid, and a status: paid → shipped (with carrier and tracking number, and its link) → delivered, or returned (from any of them). action "list" { status?, skip?, limit? } — newest first, each with its withdrawal ({ until, open, daysLeft }: the EU's 14 days from the delivery, during which the buyer may withdraw), refunded when its payment was refunded (do not ship it), test for pre's test purchases. "get" { orderId }. "update" { orderId, status?, carrier?, tracking?, trackingUrl? } — moves it on (shipped needs a carrier or a tracking number; one step back corrects a slip; returned closes it) or corrects the tracking alone. Each new state reaches the buyer's inbox in their language, with the tracking (notified: false when the app has no inbox). Labels, warehouses and returns logistics are not Neblla's: Shopify, later.

status.description: list: only these; update: the new status

trackingUrl.description: update: an https:// link to follow it

name: neblla_orders
